successCriteria.description: The `Balance` entity interface is defined in `src/modules/balance/balance.model.ts` with exactly these fields: `id: string`, `employeeId: string`, `leaveType: string`, `totalEntitlement: number`, `usedDays: number`, `remainingDays: number`, `fiscalYear: number`, `status: BalanceStatus`, `createdAt: Date`, `updatedAt: Date` — where `BalanceStatus` is imported from `src/shared/types`.

The `IBalanceRepository` interface is defined in `src/modules/balance/balance.model.ts` with exactly these async methods: `findByEmployeeId(employeeId: string): Promise<Balance[]>`, `findByEmployeeIdAndLeaveType(employeeId: string, leaveType: string): Promise<Balance | null>`, `findByEmployeeIdAndFiscalYear(employeeId: string, fiscalYear: number): Promise<Balance[]>`, `create(balance: Omit<Balance, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>): Promise<Balance>`, `update(id: string, data: Partial<Balance>): Promise<Balance | null>`, `deductDays(id: string, days: number): Promise<Balance | null>`.

The `IBalanceService` interface is defined in `src/modules/balance/balance.model.ts` with exactly these async methods: `getBalance(employeeId: string, leaveType: string): Promise<Balance | null>`, `hasSufficientBalance(employeeId: string, leaveType: string, requestedDays: number): Promise<boolean>`, `deductBalance(employeeId: string, leaveType: string, days: number): Promise<Balance>`.

The `AuditLog` entity interface is defined in `src/modules/audit-log/audit-log.model.ts` with exactly these fields: `id: string`, `entityType: string`, `entityId: string`, `action: string`, `performedBy: string`, `changes: Record<string, unknown>`, `createdAt: Date`.

The `IAuditLogRepository` interface is defined in `src/modules/audit-log/audit-log.model.ts` with exactly these async methods: `findByEntity(entityType: string, entityId: string): Promise<AuditLog[]>`, `create(entry: Omit<AuditLog, 'id' | 'createdAt'>): Promise<AuditLog>`, `findAll(filters?: { entityType?: string; performedBy?: string; fromDate?: Date; toDate?: Date }): Promise<AuditLog[]>`.

constraints: This phase produces ONLY TypeScript interfaces — no concrete classes, no implementations, no tests, no controllers, no routes, no database migrations, no app.ts registration. The two files created must contain exclusively: entity interfaces, repository interfaces, and (for balance) a service interface.

All repository and service methods must return `Promise<T>` — every method is asynchronous, consistent with the existing `IEmployeeRepository`, `ILeavePolicyRepository`, and `ILeavePolicyService` patterns.

The `Balance` entity must NOT include a `deletedAt` field — neither the reconciled architecture nor PLAN.md specifies soft-delete for Balance. The `AuditLog` entity must NOT include a `deletedAt` field — audit records are immutable and never soft-deleted.

The `create` method parameter type for both repositories must follow the established pattern: `Omit<Entity, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>` — matching `IEmployeeRepository.create` and `ILeavePolicyRepository.create`. The `AuditLog` create omits only `'id' | 'createdAt'` since AuditLog has no `updatedAt`.
outOfScope: Concrete repository implementations (PgBalanceRepository, PgAuditLogRepository) — deferred to Phase 4 (part 2/2).
Balance service implementation, controller, and routes — deferred to Phase 4 (part 2/2).
All unit tests — deferred to Phase 4 (part 2/2).

entityInvariants.invariant: `remainingDays` must always equal `totalEntitlement - usedDays`. Any operation that modifies `usedDays` (via `deductDays` or `update`) must maintain this invariant. The `status` field must be `BalanceStatus.active` when `remainingDays > 0` and `BalanceStatus.exhausted` when `remainingDays === 0`.

AuditLog records are immutable once created — there is no `update` or `delete` method on `IAuditLogRepository`. The `changes` field captures the full state delta as a `Record<string, unknown>` and must never be null or undefined.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must reject with a typed error when `days` exceeds `remainingDays` (INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE). Must reject when the balance `status` is already `exhausted`. Must reject when the balance is not found (NOT_FOUND).

Must reject with a typed error when no balance exists for the given employee + leaveType combination (NOT_FOUND). Must reject when `days` exceeds available `remainingDays` (INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE). On success, returns the updated Balance with decremented remainingDays and incremented usedDays.

Returns `false` (not an error) when no balance record exists for the given employee + leaveType. Returns `false` when `remainingDays < requestedDays`. Returns `true` only when a balance exists and `remainingDays >= requestedDays`.

Must reject with a typed error when required fields (`entityType`, `entityId`, `action`, `performedBy`, `changes`) are missing or invalid. On success, returns the created AuditLog with server-assigned `id` and `createdAt`.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `Balance.status` field must use the `BalanceStatus` enum imported from `src/shared/types/index.ts` — matching the pattern used by `Employee.employmentStatus` (EmploymentStatus enum) and `LeavePolicy.leaveType` (LeaveType enum).

The `Balance.leaveType` field must be typed as `string` (not the `LeaveType` enum) — matching the reconciled architecture specification where `leaveType` is `string` on the Balance entity, even though `LeavePolicy.leaveType` uses the `LeaveType` enum.

The `create` method parameter type must follow the exact `Omit` pattern established by `IEmployeeRepository.create`: omit server-assigned fields (`id`, timestamps). For Balance: `Omit<Balance, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>`. For AuditLog: `Omit<AuditLog, 'id' | 'createdAt'>` (AuditLog has no `updatedAt`).

integrationPoints.why: Balance entity imports `BalanceStatus` enum. The `status` field is typed as `BalanceStatus`, not a plain string.

Both Balance and AuditLog entities reference employees: `Balance.employeeId` is a string referencing an Employee `id`, and `AuditLog.performedBy` is a string referencing the employee who performed the action. The repository `create` parameter pattern (`Omit<Entity, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>`) is also derived from `IEmployeeRepository`.
